messages:
marta_cs: Quick heads-up — Nebula Health onboarding: p50 ~140ms but p95 spikes to ~2.4s under demo bursts. Renewal in ~6w. Thinking we should propose a proactive perf play (compact quant + burst routing) before renewal call.

henry_success: Thanks Marta. Can you share a short summary I can put in the renewal brief? If we can show latency + cost delta that's huge for the renewal ask.

marta_cs: Summary: tail spikes tied to long multi-turn sessions and repeated system prompts. Cache misses + KV churn. Attaching infra snippet below.

amir_infra: Saw the traces. Quick infra recs: 1) enable prefix caching for repeated system prompts 2) route >80th-percentile qps to compact-int8 during bursts 3) 48h canary in prod at low pct then ramp.

tess_ml: Model note: compact-v2-int8 gives ~30% latency improvement and ~35% cost reduction on their sample set; expected quality hit small for short-turn answers but can be visible on a handful of long-context cases. Recommend hybrid routing: steady -> base-v3 (FP16), burst -> compact-v2-int8, and automated quality checks to rollback.

nina_se: Customer SLO: they want 99th <2s ideally. They'll accept minor hit for faster replies in UI. I can coordinate a private key + an opt-in flag for the canary.

marta_cs: Can someone draft a two-paragraph playbook + canary steps I can share next week? Need ETA on eval numbers and a tiny config snippet.

amir_infra: Drafting now. Plan: canary 5% for 24h -> 25% for 48h if p95 < 2000ms and quality delta <5% on our prompt set. Config snippet:```json
{"routing_policy":"hybrid_burst","canary":[{"pct":5,"dur":"24h"},{"pct":25,"dur":"48h"}],"models":{"primary":"base-v3","compact":"compact-v2-int8"},"monitors":{"p95_ms":2000,"quality_eval":"nebula-200-sample"}}
```

tess_ml: I'll run the A/B eval on Nebula's 200 prompts tonight and post EM/accuracy proxies + 12 representative diffs tomorrow morning. If we see >5% regression we stop the rollout.

henry_success: I'll draft an ROI blurb: projected ~35% cost reduction during bursts, ~25-30% p95 improvement overall; highlight the small delta risk and the rollback guardrails.

marta_cs: Great — @redwood-bot can you open a ticket and assign to amir_infra + tess_ml, due in 10 days? Put the renewal meeting date in ticket.

redwood-bot: Ticket created: CS-9014 - nebula-perf-proactive-canary. Assignees: amir_infra, tess_ml. Due: 2026-04-03.

amir_infra: Kicking off canary infra in staging. Will post any config or autoscale issues in #eng-runtime.

tess_ml: Eval run complete — uploading summary to the ticket. Preliminary: compact-v2-int8 p95 reduced 28%, cost per 1k tokens -33%, measured quality delta ~3.8% on Nebula eval (mostly on long-chained prompts). Sharing examples in ticket.

henry_success: Perfect, I'll include these numbers in the renewal note and propose a small incentive if they adopt the hybrid routing (discount for committed months).

marta_cs: Thanks team. Keeping thread for customer comms. If any >5% quality regressions appear during canary we halt and discuss. :thumbsup:
